voice:
Pick a spot anywhere above you, and just let your eyes rest on it. Don't look away.
Notice how, the longer you stare, the heavier your eyelids become.
Heavier... and heavier... wanting to blink... wanting to close.
So heavy. So tired. So hard to keep them open.
And when they finally do close — they stay closed, and you drop into deep, soft trance.
That's it. Let go completely. Good girl.
